title: Triangle squares in coherent cone mapping simplicial sets
statement: Use small simplicial sets, joins and simplicial categories with subset-poset coherent realization $\mathfrak C$ of [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison], and marked simplicial sets of [lem-coef-marked-point-cartesian-model]. Let $K$ be any small simplicial set, let $v$ be a new cone vertex, put $P=\mathfrak C[K\star\Delta^0]$ and $X_x=P(x,v)$ for each vertex $x$ of $K$. For an edge $e:x\to y$, write $e^*:X_y\to X_x$ for precomposition by its coherent-realization vertex and $\widetilde e:\widetilde x\to e^*\widetilde y$ for the edge induced by its coning triangle. Here $\widetilde x\in X_x$ is the cone arrow from $x$ to $v$. Give $X_x$ the marking $E_x$ consisting of all degenerate edges and all $g^*\widetilde d$ with $d$ a degenerate edge of $K$ and $g\in\mathfrak C[K](x,\operatorname{source}(d))_1$; the star means the diagonal simplicial precomposition action. For every $2$-simplex $\sigma$ of $K$ with edges $e:x\to y$, $f:y\to z$, $k:x\to z$, let $\rho_\sigma$ be the edge from $k$ to the coherent composite $fe$ in $\mathfrak C[K](x,z)$ obtained from $\{0,2\}\subseteq\{0,1,2\}$. There is a simplicial square $H_\sigma:\Delta^1\times\Delta^1\to X_x$ with vertices $\widetilde x,e^*\widetilde y,k^*\widetilde z,e^*f^*\widetilde z$ at $(0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1)$ respectively, whose edges at the second coordinate $0$ and $1$ are $\widetilde e$ and $\rho_\sigma^*\widetilde z$, and whose edges at the first coordinate $0$ and $1$ are $\widetilde k$ and $e^*\widetilde f$. The edge $\rho_\sigma^*\widetilde z$ is marked in $E_x$. If $k$ is degenerate then $\widetilde k$ is marked as well. Precomposition by any vertex of $\mathfrak C[K](w,x)$ carries $E_x$ into $E_w$ and carries this square to a square with the corresponding four precomposed edges. These assertions hold for degenerate $\sigma$ as well and require neither $K$ nor its coherent mapping simplicial sets to be Kan.
